Fairness fixes in this run:
  - scc-full structural section is GOAL-selected (production `scc context structural --task`
    CLI), never ground-truth task.files (ground truth is scoring-only).
  - scc-full FINAL artifact budget enforced on the concatenated startup + task delta +
    structural text (startup N/2, task N/4, structural the remainder) — total <= N.
  - scc-atlas gets the FULL budget for the Atlas (`scc atlas --budget N`, no 13:7 split).
  - aider-repomap personalized with the same task goal (mentioned_idents) as the SCC task
    variants; one goal-personalized artifact per task.

Reading the table (mock-agent protocol; exploration = files opened + searches + graph queries):
  - first_plan_acc = the plan names a ground-truth key before any tool event; the mock names
    the FIRST source path its artifact surfaces, so it measures whether the artifact leads with
    task-relevant files. The task-personalized PPR ablations (lexical/global-ppr/task-ppr/
    ppr-mmr/ppr-quotas/ppr-optimizer) all lead with the task's APIs -> 1.000; the startup
    framings (atlas first) do not -> 0.000.
  - tokens = the artifact's chars/4 estimate (mean over tasks). Every artifact respects its
    budget; scc-full's concatenated startup+delta+structural total is enforced <= N.
  - equal conditions: same mock agent command, same fixture copies, same protocol for the
    SCC-native and external-tool variants.
